verdict.rationale: Decagon documents one agent across chat (web, mobile and "messaging platforms"), email and voice, with integrations and testing that span those channels, so the core multi-channel claim is supported. However, the specific customer channels named in the story are never identified, and in-app coverage is only implied by "mobile" chat. Missing for 10: explicit Slack support, explicit WhatsApp support, social-channel support, explicit in-app SDK/messaging documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, one agent covers chat, email, and in-app, plus the channels my customers actually use — Slack, WhatsApp, social

citations.quote: Flexible, on-brand chat built for conversations across web, mobile, and messaging platforms.
Intelligent email that understands context, stays on brand, and handles complex customer threads.
They ensure your agent can retrieve data, take action, and handle escalations smoothly across chat, email, and voice channels with no custom code required.
help teams validate agent behavior across channels before deploying to production
